answer: Before any pay lands, every identity must dock at a wharf: a random slice of its claimed work is re-performed there by strangers, and only matching work releases the earnings. Each passed inspection leaves a relic, a signed record, and an oasis of trust grows only from accumulated relics — never from payment. An honest agent passes one inspection per epoch, nearly free. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must pass 1,000 separate re-performances, each needing genuine work, and one failed inspection burns that fake's relics and flags its cluster.
